source_text:
3.28 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ· περὶ ἀραχνίων Τῶν
ἀραχνίων εἴδη πολλά. Τὰ δὲ ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀδικῆσαι δυνάμενα δύο, μαινόλης καὶ
χαλκίς. Τοῖς μὲν οὖν ὑπὸ μαινόλους πληγεῖσιν ὑσσώπου ἢ ὀριγάνου ˉγˉο δʹ στατ· δʹ
ἁλός τε πεφρυγμένου ἴσον λείου καὶ σὺν μέλιτι ἐπιτίθει· ἢ κύμινον ὅσον τοῖς τρισὶ
δακτύλοις συνέχειν ἄγνου τε καρπὸν τὸ ἴσον μετ' οἴνου ˉγˉο γʹ ἐγχυμάτιζε. ∆ιδόναι
δὲ καὶ μάζας καὶ σκόροδα καὶ † λαβῶν ἐπωφελὲς διὰ στόματος † <...>.
pass_a_gloss: 3.28 Of-the-same: about spiderlings. Of-the-spiderlings kinds many. The but from them to-wrong being-able two, mainoles and chalkis. To-those yes then by mainoles having-been-struck of-hyssop or of-oregano ounces 4, staters 4, of-salt both having-been-roasted equal pound and with honey set-on; or cumin as-much with-the-three fingers to-hold of-agnus both fruit the equal with wine ounces 3 drench. To-give but also mazas and garlics and † having-taken beneficial through mouth † [lacuna].
pass_b_english: Of the same: about spiderlings. There are many kinds of spiderlings. Those able to wrong from them are two: mainoles and chalkis. To those struck by mainoles, then: four ounces of hyssop or oregano, four staters, and an equal of roasted salt, pound and set on with honey; or cumin as much as the three fingers hold, and an equal of agnus-fruit, drench with three ounces of wine. Give also mazas and garlics, and † having taken, beneficial through the mouth † [lacuna].

choices.why: Lock species-names, not translated as 'mad one' and 'bronze one'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
